# Parallel Map Backend Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Implement `par_map` in `src/parallel/map.rs` as Xenon's pure parallel single-input mapping backend, preserving serial semantics while materializing a new owned result tensor with the same dimension as the input.

**Architecture:** `par_map` is a crate-internal backend function consumed after `dispatch.rs` has already selected the parallel path. It splits logical work into deterministic chunks, runs read-only mapping work in Rayon, keeps result ordering stable, and returns a freshly allocated owned tensor.

**Tech Stack:** Rust 1.85+, edition 2024, optional `rayon` 1.10, `TensorBase`, `Storage`, `Dimension`, `Element`

**Design Docs:** `design/09-parallel.md` §5.3, §6.2, §6.4, §8.2; `design/00-coding.md` §2.5, §3, §8.1, §8.2

**Prerequisites:** W14T1 (`src/parallel/mod.rs`) must be complete.

Replace `src/parallel/map.rs` with the following content:

```rust
#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
use rayon::prelude::*;

use crate::dimension::Dimension;
use crate::element::Element;
use crate::storage::Storage;
use crate::tensor::{Tensor, TensorBase};

use super::ParallelExecStrategy;

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
fn resolve_chunk_ranges(total: usize, strategy: &ParallelExecStrategy) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
    if total == 0 {
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let num_threads = strategy
        .max_workers
        .unwrap_or_else(rayon::current_num_threads)
        .max(1);
    let chunk_size = strategy
        .chunk_size
        .unwrap_or_else(|| usize::max(1, (total + num_threads - 1) / num_threads));

    let mut ranges = Vec::new();
    let mut start = 0;
    while start < total {
        let end = usize::min(start + chunk_size, total);
        ranges.push((start, end));
        start = end;
    }
    ranges
}

#[cfg(feature = "parallel")]
pub(crate) fn par_map<S, A, B, D, F>(
    tensor: &TensorBase<S, D>,
    strategy: &ParallelExecStrategy,
    f: F,
) -> Tensor<B, D>
where
    S: Storage<Elem = A>,
    D: Dimension + Clone,
    A: Element + Send + Sync,
    B: Element + Send,
    F: Fn(&A) -> B + Send + Sync,
{
    let dim = tensor.raw_dim();
    let total = tensor.len();
    let ranges = resolve_chunk_ranges(total, strategy);

    let parts: Vec<Vec<B>> = ranges
        .into_par_iter()
        .map(|(start, end)| {
            tensor
                .iter()
                .skip(start)
                .take(end - start)
                .map(&f)
                .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        })
        .collect();

    let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(total);
    for part in parts {
        output.extend(part);
    }

    unsafe { Tensor::from_raw_vec_unchecked(output, dim) }
}

#[cfg(all(test, feature = "parallel"))]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::dimension::Ix1;
    use crate::tensor::Tensor;

    #[test]
    fn test_par_map_parallel_path() {
        let tensor = Tensor::<i32, Ix1>::from_shape_vec(Ix1(6), vec![1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]).unwrap();
        let strategy = ParallelExecStrategy {
            chunk_size: Some(2),
            max_workers: None,
        };

        let mapped = par_map(&tensor, &strategy, |x| x * 3);

        assert_eq!(mapped.shape(), &[6]);
        assert_eq!(mapped.iter().copied().collect::<Vec<_>>(), vec![3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18]);
    }
}
```
